consulted_citations.field: PDF p. 283, printed p. 271; 爾(尔) headword; full entry and glyph sequence inspected in scan
consulted_citations.text: I inspected the scan pixels for the 爾 headword, glyph sequence, cited forms, and complete entry. This entry gives an account in which an early graph depicted a silk-reeling frame, later graphic change yielded 爾/尔 shapes, and 爾 was borrowed for second-person pronoun use. It also describes a later compound-looking form and the simplification/remerger of 爾 and 尔. This is a book-specific analysis of 爾/尔, not direct evidence for the formation or phonetic role of 尔 in 你. The entry and OCR agree in the claims reported here; no OCR correction is proposed.
